_about: Reader goal templates (GDTA shape: goal -> decision -> SA requirement at L1 perceive / L2 comprehend / L3 project). Domain-agnostic: every row is answered from a field the pipeline produces for ANY staged window. {dev} = one development. scope page = answered once per page. 'data' = the field path in /api/raw/developments. Per-reader priorities (follow list, goal weights) are an OPTIONAL override that changes ranking only; they are never required to run.

monitor.goal: Know what changed since my last look
monitor.decision: Do I need to look at this now?

requirements.q: How many developments have new reporting since the last look?
Does {dev} have new reporting since the last look?
Did the certainty word of {dev} change since the last look, and to what?
How many new assertions did {dev} gain since the last look?

decide.goal: Know whether I can act on it
decide.decision: Is this well enough sourced, and who disagrees?

requirements.q: How well sourced is {dev} (single source / reported / established / disputed)?
How many independent publisher owners report {dev}?
Do sources disagree about {dev}, and who are the two sides?

explain.goal: Know who is involved, where, when and why
explain.decision: Who do I need to talk to or watch; is this connected to what I already follow?

requirements.q: Which people or organisations are involved in {dev}?
What cause do the sources state for {dev}?
When was {dev} first reported, and over how many days?
Which other development shares a named entity with {dev}?

anticipate.decision: What do I expect, and what would change my judgment?

requirements.q: What do sources say will happen next in {dev}, and who says it?
Which developments carry no forward statement?
How many developments carry a forward statement?

retain.goal: Carry the state in my head until next time
retain.decision: What is the one line I keep?

requirements.q: What is the one-line state of {dev}?
Which development leads the page, and why?

ranking: disputed+moved > moved > disputed > forward statement only > unchanged; ties by owners desc, then articles desc. Priorities override: a development touching a followed entity moves to the top of its band (never changes certainty).
